items.title: Marvell Stock Had A Huge Year And Still Sits Well Below Its High
items.summary: Marvell Technology (MRVL) stock returned 235.9% over the past year, climbing from $62.18 to $208.83. The company kept raising what it expects to sell, and buyers repriced it each time. Then the shares pulled back, and they now sit well below their best.
